summary: A group of projects, programmes and other portfolios that your organisation chooses between and funds against its strategy.
example: Cooperative Investment Portfolio, which decides each season which of the quality, market access and member services work to fund first.
definition: A set of projects, programmes and other portfolios that your organisation ranks and decides whether to fund, based on its goals and objectives. The work in it need not be related. A portfolio records the goals and objectives it ranks against, the budgets it hands out, the team that decides, and each decision: invest, hold or stop. It is not a programme (related work toward one change), not a project (work with a start and an end), and not a collection (your own grouping, which decides nothing).

cues.portfolio: a set of projects ranked and funded against the strategy

/metadata/name.guide: The portfolio's name, as people refer to it.

poor.why: Names what is in it today, not what it decides to fund.

/spec/aim.guide: What the portfolio funds and why.
good: Fund the work that most raises what members earn from each season's produce.

poor.text: Coordinate the quality projects so they deliver one standard.
poor.why: That is a programme's aim: one change brought about by related work. A portfolio decides what to fund.

/spec/objectives.guide: The goals and objectives the portfolio ranks its work against. Outcomes cannot be chosen.

poor.why: This is an outcome. Choose a goal or objective.

/spec/leadTeam.guide: The team that governs the portfolio: it selects what goes in, sets the order, and decides what to invest in, hold or stop. A team, never a person.

/spec/funding.guide: The budgets the portfolio hands out. Projects and programmes in it can also have their own budgets.

/spec/reviewCycle.guide: How often the portfolio's decisions are reviewed, if on a fixed cycle.

/spec/portfolios.guide: The portfolios this one is part of, when portfolios nest: a regional portfolio inside the organisation's. Leave empty for a top-level portfolio.

Programme:/spec/portfolios.ask: Which programmes does this portfolio fund and prioritise? A programme names the portfolios it is in, so open each programme and choose this portfolio.
Programme:/spec/portfolios.ifNone: Open each programme this portfolio funds and choose this portfolio there.

Project:/spec/alignment/portfolios.ask: Which projects does this portfolio fund and prioritise, outside any programme it holds? A project names the portfolios it is in, so open the project and choose this portfolio.
Project:/spec/alignment/portfolios.ifNone: Open each project this portfolio funds and choose this portfolio there.

Portfolio:/spec/portfolios.ask: Which portfolios sit inside this one? A portfolio names the portfolios it is part of.
Portfolio:/spec/portfolios.ifNone: Put a portfolio inside this one only when it has its own team making its own decisions.

checks.portfolio-objectives: Name the strategic objectives the portfolio is prioritised against.
checks.portfolio-holds: Open each project, programme or portfolio in it and choose this portfolio.
checks.portfolio-decided: Record a decision for each project, programme or portfolio in it: invest, hold or stop, with a priority and a reason.
